run_eval_wordstat_cli: run the eval_wordstat script to compute word statistics from model predictions on a task
get_word_stats_function: get word frequency and length statistics for text using a dictionary agent and frequency bins
setup_args_parser: setup a ParlaiParser with arguments for num examples, freq bins, external dict, and dump path
eval_wordstat_function: evaluate a model on a task and compute word statistics including unique responses and token counts
EvalWordStat_class: run the EvalWordStat ParlaiScript class to evaluate word statistics from model predictions
